reviews.summary: ICNT has a recurring vesting/unlock overhang: an unlock occurred November 3, 2026 and the next scheduled release is December 3, 2026. This is directly relevant near-term supply-event risk; no current exploit or unresolved project outage was found.
materialRisks: Recurring ICNT vesting releases: the November 3, 2026 release was estimated at 5.8% of market cap, with another 19.66M ICNT scheduled for December 3, 2026 (2.8% of total supply; estimated 5.5% of market cap).
The December release is allocated substantially to private investors and insiders (combined 76.2%), increasing potential distribution/selling-pressure risk around the event.

facts.fact: ICNT is the native token of Impossible Cloud Network, matching the ICNT-EUR market identity.
The project’s token-distribution document sets a 700M total supply and includes investor/team allocations subject to vesting.
Third-party unlock tracking lists a November 3, 2026 unlock and a December 3, 2026 unlock of 19,662,156 ICNT.
Impossible Cloud’s status page shows recent regional S3 performance incidents as resolved and currently reports systems operational.
